Effect: {Hand}[Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (One of your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[When Digivolving][When Attacking][Once Per Turn] By deleting 1 Digimon with the [Deva] trait or 6000 DP or less, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ for the turn.
